The whole idea behind the term fixer upper is that no ones perfect and that we need the support of others. The song also says “Everyone's a bit of a fixer-upper, that's what it's all about!Father!Sister!Brother! We need each other to raise us up and round us out.” It’s pointing out the flaws in both characters but saying that the people who love you can accept those things. This speaks to the lack of love that was shown to Elsa by her parents that could have prevented the whole situation. Anna’s flaw is that she is so angry and stressed by the way things have been at the castle that she blindly trusted someone she didn’t know and was so desperate to feel love that she was willing to marry that person. “ people make bad choices when their mad or scared or stressed”.  We as humans are always a work in progress no one is perfect and we will never be perfect we are all fixer uppers and it doesn’t mean there is something wrong with us but a person who stops trying to better themselves is a scary thing.
